items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Erstausstattung benefit
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: The letter is dated Fri 10 Apr 2026. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a letter sent by post from a social-law authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Tue 14 Apr 2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts running on 15 Apr 2026 and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. Thu 14 May 2026. That day is Christi Himmelfahrt, a public holiday in Hessen, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next business day, Fri 15 May 2026.

warnings: The computed Widerspruch deadline (15 May 2026) has already passed relative to today's date (26 September 2026); if this letter has only just come to attention, check with the Jobcenter whether a late objection or Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand is still possible.
No monetary amount is stated in the letter because it is a rejection of the requested benefit, not a payment demand.
